about: PROPOSED, UNSIGNED. One Proofline task, XC-74, part of the 'cover ALL' decomposition (XC-54 to XC-78) drafted on 2026-10-25 from public sources. Nothing here is binding and vv does not read this file. It becomes part of the contract only when the owner merges it into proofline.json and re-signs it with the owner key pinned in guard/owner.pub. Every criterion except scope, pushed and the unchanged-suite guards fails on the v1.6.0 tree. Evidence is testnet-only, loopback-only and verify-only unless the task says otherwise; hosted facilitators are never called. Estimated effort: 6-8 days.

not_contract_tasks.keys: Throwaway testnet keys and faucet tokens are created on the owner's machine and live in X402C_KEYS outside the repository. No spend, no mainnet.
not_contract_tasks.disclosure: A failing third-party column is reported to that project privately first (SECURITY.md). Until the window clears its row says 'under disclosure' with no per-check detail.

tasks.title: Open-source facilitators, batch C (non-EVM): Sui, NEAR, Stellar, Solana and others
tasks.description: sui-x402-facilitator, fastnear/x402-facilitator, agentsmith-oss, x402-stellar-bazaar, Rialto, lumenbazaar, walras, aether, pr402, x402-cash-facilitator, OpenZeppelin relayer plugin (with a self-hosted Relayer), x402-gonka if a public testnet exists.

criteria.statement: At least 10 additional open-source facilitators are built at pinned commits and have evidence, or a setup-failure record with the reason
Every committed run under evidence/self-hosted/batch-c is on an allow-listed testnet CAIP-2 id, called nothing off loopback and made zero /settle calls
No facilitator in the batch was contacted at a hosted URL
The full offline suite passes unchanged
Every changed file is inside this task's scope

stop_rules: If a criterion cannot pass, STOP and report what blocks it, what was tried and what is needed. Never weaken a criterion, skip a test or raise a timeout to make it pass.

Testnet only: never use a mainnet CAIP-2 id, never fund a key with anything but testnet faucet tokens, never call a hosted facilitator; every facilitator under test is the owner's own instance on 127.0.0.1.
A failing third-party result is not published with per-check detail until SECURITY.md's disclosure window clears; if a criterion would need that detail to pass, STOP and report.
